key_insight: Robust PPO for small language model agents depends more on having a fluent supervised prior and a reliable reward signal than on raw parameter count.
engineering_relevance: The paper provides practical fixes for unstable RLHF-style training in small models, including adapter reinitialization, float32 PPO updates, and rollback safeguards.
method: Train SLMs with PPO across multiple model/corpus pairs.
Fix silent PEFT/TRL LoRA freezing via merge-and-reinitialize adapters.
Stabilize optimization with float32 updates plus reward whitening, ratio guarding, and rollback.
evidence_signal: Across 15 model–corpus configurations, the proposed safeguards produced stable convergence and improved preference win rate over SFT, with stronger gains when the prior was fluent and the reward signal was informative.
watch_item: The method still depends on a sufficiently good reward model; if reward quality is weak, policy collapse can still occur despite the safeguards.
paper_title: Towards Robust Reinforcement Learning for Small-Scale Language Model Agents
